name: v0.52.735
body:
## What's Changed
* Release exp-v0.52.733: streaming: retry a failed compressor rebind on the next turn (#9215) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9270
* fix(streaming): harden the cached-agent compressor rebind (#9150 follow-up) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9215
* Release exp-v0.52.734: profiles: refuse memory/skill writes made for a profile that is no longer active (#9216) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9274
* fix(profiles): refuse Memory save and skill toggle writes made from another profile's data by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9216
* docs(changelog): stamp v0.52.727 by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9277
* docs(changelog): stamp v0.52.731 by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9288
* Release exp-v0.52.735: ledger retry-timer test waits for the fired timer (#9287) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9291
* test: wait for the fired ledger retry timer to exit before counting live timers by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9287


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/compare/v0.52.732...v0.52.735
